name: WeWork India Management Limited
summary: WeWork India Management Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the rental and operation of office buildings and coworking spaces in India. The company offers office spaces, including private and managed offices; coworking spaces; and value-added services such as fit-out customization, events and hospitality, F&B services, technology services, overages, shoots and studios, parking, and solutions for global capability centers. It also provides advertising services through digital signage, ads in community newsletters, tabletops and standees, in-app and email notifications, and brand promotional spaces.
